# Combined affix lines roll as a single shared value

- **Status:** ✅ Confirmed
- **Mechanic tags:** gear, affix, crafting, rolling
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-09 by Owner (in-game domain knowledge, 2026-08-09)

## Setup

In-game, an affix line that grants multiple stats from ONE roll (e.g. a weapon suffix '+X% Attack and Cast Speed +X% Minion Attack and Cast Speed') uses a single rolled value for all its parts — the numbers on that one line are always identical. Our data stores such a line as one affix entry with multiple numeric_values that carry an identical range.

## Raw data points

Combined lines pair numeric_values with an identical range where the two halves are the SAME stat — the player/minion mirror ('+(109–122)% Attack and Cast Speed +(109–122)% Minion Attack and Cast Speed', or the 'X for Minions' suffix form) and same-stat conditional splits. Validated against SS13 data: 328 craft mirror lines group correctly; every distinct-stat pair that merely shares a range stays independent (e.g. legendary '+(40–60)% Ignite damage +(40–60)% chance to Ignite targets', 'Block' vs 'Block Ratio', 'Elemental Resistance' vs 'Erosion Resistance').

## Derived / confirmed formula

Roll constraint (not a DPS formula): within one affix entry, numeric_values are ONE shared roll when they have an identical range (kind/sign/min/max) AND the same underlying stat — the stat text between number tokens, compared after normalizing away the Minion qualifier (both 'Minion X' prefix and 'X for Minions' suffix) and trailing condition clauses (when/while/against/during/if …). A single control then drives the group and writes the same value to every index. Two DISTINCT stats that only coincidentally share a range are NOT grouped; distinct ranges and fixed values never group.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Grouping rule = same entry + identical range + same underlying stat (owner 2026-08-09: NARROW to genuine combined/mirror lines; two distinct stats sharing a range — e.g. Ignite damage vs chance to Ignite — must NOT be locked). The stat check is a text heuristic (Minion + condition normalization) validated against SS13 data with zero false positives; it conservatively leaves a few ambiguous conditional splits (e.g. 'Regenerates Life/s' vs '… when taking DoT') independent, which is the safe direction (no regression vs prior independent-roll behavior). Existing saved builds are NOT rewritten on load — the shared control seeds from the group's representative index and only locks the halves together on user edit. Applies wherever the pattern occurs (weapon/gear suffixes, craft, grafts, random affixes); the hero-memory creator already stores a single value per affix so it was already effectively one shared roll.

## Implementation (engine model)

WIRED (renderer, edit-time only). affixText.sharedRollGroups(numeric_values) groups indices by identical range. The gear roll editors (GearScreen: legendary/gear range rows, the random-affix placeholder slider, craft slots, and vorax/graft slots) render ONE control per group and fan the value to every index in the group in a single state update. No data/codec change — chosen_values stays index-keyed and is written in lockstep, and reconstructAffixText is unchanged. mod_parser already fans a combined 'X and Y' text to multiple stat keys at COMPUTE time, so this only closes the EDIT-time gap where a user could otherwise roll the halves to disagreeing values (impossible in-game).
